clarifications.title: Applicant Type Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The case should confirm whether the applicant is applying individually or with family dependents. Family cases require a dependent count.

clarifications.title: Retirement Status Requirement
clarifications.clarification: Costa Rica Pensionado temporary residence is for an applicant who is retired from their habitual occupation and receives pension income. If the applicant is not retired, the case does not appear to meet this core category requirement.

clarifications.title: Pension Income Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The monthly pension income amount is missing or could not be interpreted as a numeric USD amount. The US$1,000/month threshold cannot be confirmed automatically.

clarifications.title: Minimum Pension Income
clarifications.clarification: The reference requirement states that the applicant must receive pension income greater than or equal to US$1,000 per month. Pension income below that amount is a disqualifying factor for this screening.

clarifications.title: Pension Source Review
clarifications.clarification: The pension should come from Social Security, a government pension, a private pension, or a retirement-benefit certificate. Other sources should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Retirement-Based Pension Requirement
clarifications.clarification: The pension must arise from retirement or a similar pension benefit. For an applicant who selected an "Other" pension source and confirmed the income is not paid as a retirement or pension benefit, this does not appear to satisfy the pensionado category.

clarifications.title: Pension Duration Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The pension should be reviewed to confirm whether it is lifetime, indefinite, or otherwise sufficiently ongoing to support Pensionado residency. A pension with a scheduled end date, or unclear duration, requires manual review.

clarifications.title: Not a Work-Authorizing Category
clarifications.clarification: Pensionado status is based on pension income, not Costa Rican employment. If the applicant plans to work in Costa Rica, the case does not appear to satisfy this core category requirement.

clarifications.title: Dependent Count
clarifications.clarification: If dependents are included, the application should identify how many dependents are part of the case.

clarifications.title: Valid Passport
clarifications.clarification: The applicant must maintain a valid passport or travel document. A passport that is not currently valid should be renewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Criminal Background Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: A disclosed criminal record should be reviewed before Pensionado eligibility is confirmed. Costa Rica may evaluate criminal background information case by case.

clarifications.title: Pension Receipt in Costa Rica
clarifications.clarification: Pensionados/rentistas must demonstrate that they received the qualifying income in Costa Rica and converted it into national currency when required. Bank or exchange records may be needed.

clarifications.title: CCSS Renewal Status
clarifications.clarification: For renewal where applicable, residents must prove CCSS or Costa Rican social insurance coverage. Cases without registration or a plan to register after approval need manual review.

clarifications.title: Biennial Renewal
clarifications.clarification: Pensionado temporary residence must be renewed every 2 years. Renewal may require updated status, pension, CCSS, and DIMEX evidence.

clarifications.title: Manual Review Required
clarifications.clarification: The information provided is not enough to confirm Costa Rica Pensionado eligibility automatically. The case should be reviewed manually so the team can identify the appropriate next step.
